ranked.headline: Coupling single-cell transcriptomes to chromatin, spatial and perturbation axes
ranked.summary: Unpaired and paired single-cell multi-omic data are now modeled jointly for expression prediction, integration, and perturbation response.

ranked.headline: Software tools automate metadata extraction and peptide matching in proteomics
ranked.summary: RunAssessor targets manual curation burden for public proteomics data, and several 2026 tools package reusable matching and visualization workflows.

ranked.headline: Learned models couple histology, spatial omics and clinical data to outcome endpoints
ranked.summary: Multimodal models now link H&E, spatial omics and clinical variables to recurrence, survival and immunotherapy endpoints in recent studies.

ranked.headline: Single-cell scoring links kidney GWAS heritability to specific cell populations and genes
ranked.summary: Cell-resolved atlases now allow GWAS trait heritability to be attributed to specific cell populations and candidate genes.

ranked.headline: Graph and multimodal models predict drug, toxicity and protein-binding properties
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test graph and sequence representations on leakage-free or external-validation splits, revealing where predictive gains are limited.

ranked.headline: Causal and network-based models quantify feedback and metabolic state in cells
ranked.summary: Recent studies read out cellular state through causal perturbation, genome-scale metabolic networks, and spectral data, linking network structure to function.

ranked.headline: Computational models link protein structure to units, disorder, and interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair structure-aware learning with proteome-scale prediction of interactions, units, and drug-atom attribution.

ranked.headline: Structural graphs and ensembles condition antibody and protein prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints condition antibody and protein predictors on residue graphs, MD-derived frames, and conformational ensembles rather than sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Single-cell benchmarks and simulators for drug response and perturbation inference
ranked.summary: April 2026 work benchmarks, simulates, and infers single-cell perturbation, clonal, and regulatory structure while testing method stability against explicit…

ranked.headline: Protein structure guides ligand and binder prioritization with explicit benchmarking
ranked.summary: Pocket-similarity queries, synthetic pose datasets, and proteome-wide docking now feed explicit benchmarks and validation.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods for population-scale, temporal, and spatial omics data analysis
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial, temporal, and population-scale datasets now demand models that respect design structure and temporal dependence.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models pair batch-invariant embeddings with perturbation response generation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether single-cell representations generalize across layers, batches, and perturbation types rather than fitting a single task.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict immune recognition from sequence, structure and immunopeptidomics
ranked.summary: Fused sequence-structure, fairness-constrained and unified transformer models now target binding, presentation and self-association.

ranked.headline: Fusing sequence, structure, and dynamics embeddings for protein and RNA prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair protein language models with structure, dynamics, and biophysical priors for fitness, binding, and RNA scoring tasks.

ranked.headline: MD simulations of Aβ42 and disordered-protein regions map early aggregation-prone states
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 papers apply restrained and descriptor-based MD to amyloid-β and DPF3, targeting transient aggregation-prone states.

ranked.headline: Variant Effect Prediction for Indels, Structural and Regulatory Variants
ranked.summary: Clinical calibration of in-frame indel predictors and tissue-specific dosage metrics for structural variants extends interpretation beyond missense.

ranked.headline: Sparse, compositional, and sequence-derived models are reshaping microbial inference
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and installable tools now bring sparse regression, network inference, and k-mer and protein language models to microbial analysis.

ranked.headline: Conditioned generative models steer de novo molecular design via diffusion, LLMs, and RL
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair diffusion and language-model generators with RL steering and explicit 3D or pocket constraints for goal-directed design.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in tool docs, literature graphs and containers for bioinformatics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints ground agent outputs in checkable resources, including version-specific documentation, skill graphs, and containerized tools.

ranked.headline: Imaging-registered spatial transcriptomics maps organ zonation and volumetric structure
ranked.summary: Matched imaging and spatial transcriptomics now resolve adult zonation, volumetric cardiomyocyte profiles, and postnatal brain vascularization phases.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models infer chromatin accessibility and binding across species
ranked.summary: Cross-species and deep learning models now infer accessibility, binding, and 3D chromatin organization from sequence and accessibility data.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed neural models predict molecular and protein-level properties with…
ranked.summary: A new survey and benchmark of deep learning for molecular property prediction arrives alongside quantum-informed pKa and protein phase-separation predictors.

ranked.headline: Graph databases and fast streaming tools reshape population genomics data processing
ranked.summary: Five 2026 preprints pair graph-database storage and computation with faster VCF filtering and variant annotation for population-scale genomics.

ranked.headline: Condensate interfaces are proposed to enhance amyloid nucleation in FD-MD simulations
ranked.summary: Recent FD-MD simulations suggest condensate interfaces shape amyloid nucleation and fibril morphology, beyond bulk kinetic views.

ranked.headline: Conformational and protonation states govern enzyme function and flagellar rotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published QM/MM study treat protonation, hydration, and conformational gating as state-switching elements of catalysis.

ranked.headline: Queryable omics tools expose gene hierarchy, sample trendlines and feature synergy
ranked.summary: Queryable web and analysis tools now expose gene hierarchy, sample trendlines and pairwise microbiome feature synergy from bulk omics data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of stochastic evolution in finite microbial populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply analytic weak-selection, mean-field and phase-transition formalisms to microbial genomic and lineage structure.

ranked.headline: Simulation-guided sampling maps channel blocker sites and dynamic protein states
ranked.summary: MD and adaptive sampling now resolve state-specific channel conformations, ligand binding sites, and dynamics-guided protein redesign.

ranked.headline: Sequence models extend to DNA classification, read correction and RNA prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published RNA model extend sequence foundation models to classification, read correction, and interpretable feature learning.

ranked.headline: Generative models sample protein and molecular conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Generative models now sample protein and molecular conformational states directly, offering alternatives to conventional molecular dynamics sampling.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models link transport, wave propagation and lineage fluctuations in cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply explicit dynamical formalisms to organelle, signaling and lineage dynamics, though none report experimental validation.

ranked.headline: New methods extend single-cell readouts to tRNAs, CRISPRi chromatin and total RNA
ranked.summary: Single-cell assays now pair multilayer CRISPRi readouts, full-length total RNA and low-input tRNA profiling with quantitative scoring and simulation.

ranked.headline: Long-read and complete assemblies expose variation missed by standard reference genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and complete-reference assemblies now resolve mitochondrial, Y-chromosome, and canine variation beyond standard reference-anchored callsets.

ranked.headline: Conductance models link ion transport to neuronal firing and seizure transitions
ranked.summary: Recent models extend ion channel and chloride homeostasis frameworks from single-cell excitability to network-scale seizure dynamics.

ranked.headline: Genetic variants, 3D genome folding and cell-type context shape regulatory chromatin
ranked.summary: Cross-species methylation atlases, Plate-C 3D screens and cell-type sex-effect maps now test regulatory activity within its genetic and chromatin context.

ranked.headline: LLM systems grounding biological reasoning in knowledge graphs and verified literature
ranked.summary: Multi-agent LLM frameworks now attempt citation-backed and mechanistic explanations, requiring verification against structured biological knowledge.

ranked.headline: Platform-specific artifacts distort low-VAF somatic calls and ctDNA inference
ranked.summary: Platform chemistry artifacts now directly confound low-VAF somatic calls, prompting read filtering and improved deconvolution methods.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines quantify chimeric and single-cell transcript expression
ranked.summary: Quantitative tools now resolve chimeric RNA abundance, per-cell transcript counts, and circadian isoform dynamics in mouse liver.
